title: Establish integration_branch and Integrator review logic for multi-task workflows
task_summary: Introduced dynamic integration branch creation for multi-task workflows. Added AccountRole.INTEGRATOR. Refactored per-task branching to derive off the integration branch. Implemented a post-QA, pre-final-PR Integrator review session to catch cross-agent integration issues, with approval/rejection logic managing final PR merges and branch cleanup.

files_changed.change: Added workflows.integration_branch schema definitions and automatic migration handler.
Added integration_branch attribute to Pydantic Workflow model.
Extended GitHubClient with get_branch_sha, create_branch_with_base, merge_branch, delete_branch, and create_pull_request.
Refactored all API methods to route entirely through clients/github.py instead of raw httpx calls.
Created integration branch on GitHub at workflow dispatch, and implemented the full integrator review pipeline including final PR merge and branch cleanup.
Updated run_task to base task branches off the integration_branch if available.
Modified merge_when_ready to merge task branches into the integration branch upon completion, and to lookup Integrator review verdicts for known integration branch PRs.
Added comprehensive test test_integrator_workflow_review to verify the Integrator review dispatch and approve/reject paths.

assumptions_verified.verification: Parsed structured JSON from Integrator activities, matching QA's template format.
Wrote test_integrator_workflow_review confirming task branches are branched from integration_branch if multi-task.

decisions.decision: Pass target base_branch to GitHubClient branch creation helper
decisions.reasoning: Determines base branch dynamically (integration branch or fallback default branch), avoiding hardcoded values and preserving single-task behavior.

self_review.checked: All modified files, schema changes, and test executions.

notes_for_next_step: Step 6.1 is fully completed and thoroughly verified. The multi-task Integrator review pipeline is completely active and tested.
